title: THE BOARD STARTS FRESH IN CREDITS
why: A low finding of the arcade31 review. Party board rows saved before the arcade score became credits hold scores with loot worth one tenth, but they now show with a $ next to full value rows, so BEST EVER and NEW HIGH SCORE compared two different scales. Every board row is now written with a scale tag. When the board loads, old rows without the tag are dropped and the board is saved back clean, once. Only the arcade board changes; his save and normal raids are untouched.
now: The arcade party board starts fresh in credits: old scale rows are dropped once, so every score on it is on one scale.
